summary: Musk expects AI and robots to bring widespread abundance, acknowledges serious risks and has called for AI labs to test each other’s models.

statements.quote: What I think would be wise to do as soon as possible, if not immediately, would be to have the major AI competitors test each other’s models.
The most likely outcome is an age of amazing abundance where anyone can have anything they can think of.
Universal HIGH INCOME via checks issued by the Federal government is the best way to deal with unemployment caused by AI.
I don’t think humans will be in control of something that is vastly more intelligent than humans.
I mean, we need to be very careful with AI. We need to be very careful with robotics.
